ns2:section.sectionText: In this course, you and other students in the course will form your own "agency" to work on a project for a local client. The course is a crash course in agency management, client services, and production with the scope of the projects being directed by your client's needs. Please see the course website http://illinoissandageproject.wordpress.com/ for more information or to apply to register for the course. Questions can be directed to the course instructor: Katrina Olson (katrinao@illinois.edu)
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or Agricultural Communications major(s). Restricted to students with Senior class standing.
